issues.title: DUPLO sim-to-real実験記録：校正片の接続・実測と通常高さ2×2への移植結果
DUPLO互換ボールレール：実測寸法・断面推定・接続検証

rail.functional_fit: Very loose; falls off by tilting without pulling. Explicit functional FAIL.
rail.prior_functional_fit: slightly loose; attaches and detaches easily
rail.physical_rolling_feedback: Existing straight rail and 2-high straight tunnel: joint crossing, running length/alignment, corners, sagging and burrs reported satisfactory. Does not validate sloped curve.

receiver_comparison.fit: tight; slightly difficult to remove; same in repeat test
best; removable; same in repeat test
very loose; falls off on tilt

tunnel_stud.fit: very loose; separate from receiver correction; no upper studs on this curve

decisions.global_scale: Keep grid and envelope. Actual straight rail/tunnel rolling and running length now reported satisfactory; do not compensate earlier length measurement globally.
decisions.port_grid: Keep 16 mm pitch, 4x4 envelope, 19.2 mm drop and end rail profile.
decisions.receiver: Current printable curve retains OD13.30/ID9.40 and wall3.16 only as an UNCORRECTED baseline, not an adequate production-fit choice. Tube-only expansion is unsupported: the best coupon had a smaller tube than the loose tunnel. Side-wall contact is the stronger current hypothesis.
decisions.fit_status: Receiver calibration REQUIRED before claiming retention solved. Current curve is a shape/rolling prototype and may inherit or worsen known retention failure. No fit repair implemented or physically validated.
decisions.floor_removal: Remove unused inner/outer corner floors and tube portions; do not add curved receiver walls that obstruct the 16 lower studs.

wall_candidates.status: unprinted hypotheses from latest comment; no guaranteed linear print compensation
wall_candidates.transfer_limit: Curved footprint removes opposing receiver walls. A successful rectangular 2x2 wall setting cannot be transferred blindly; actual curve attachment contacts must be evaluated.

decisions.calibration_causality: Same CAD inner span25.48 produced coupon25.22/25.18 and tunnel25.43/25.34; shape/print effects remain unseparated. No unsupported wear/aging explanation introduced.

validation.reference: Synthetic nominal DUPLO 4x4, 16 hollow studs OD9.40,height4.50
validation.physical_reference_feedback: Straight rail and straight tunnel have failed retention despite nominal-CAD trial interference. That interference is only a CAD result, not evidence of sufficient printed clutch force.

review_history.summary: Initial assessment before 3 new comments; no dimension compensation adopted.
